title: S2 — from-scratch glyph CNN (training pipeline + committed recipe)
desc: Train a small per-glyph network on generator data only (CPU, no pretrained downloads), with a recipe and seed so anyone can reproduce it. Weights < 10MB are committed; otherwise the recipe is the artefact.
